title: Zells shin measurements
$comment: Variable names CONFIRMED 2026-07-02 against the Onshape model's variable table (S1_ISW..S4_OD plus Leg_Length). Slices S1-S4 sit at 20/40/60/80 percent of Leg_Length measured up from the bottom of the ankle; Leg_Length runs from the bottom of the ankle to the knee. All values are millimeters. 1.1.0 (2026-11-10): these are LEG measurements, as extraction and manual entry produce them. The Onshape model's variables with the same names are a different quantity (crest-relative points on the guard's inner curve, docs/DESIGN.md 12.2); the pipeline converts leg measurements to model values in exactly one place, services/pipeline/src/forms_pipeline/cad/profile.py, selected by the CAD descriptor's profile. Renames still require a coordinated schema version bump across TS, Python, and the Onshape model.

Leg_Length.description: Leg length from the bottom of the ankle to the knee, in millimeters.

S1_ISW.description: Width of the inner (medial) half of the cross-section, split at the section centroid (ISW + ICW = OW) at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.

S1_ISD.description: Front-to-back depth of the inner (medial) half of the cross-section at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.

S1_ICW.description: Width of the outer (lateral) half of the cross-section, split at the section centroid (ISW + ICW = OW) at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.

S1_ICD.description: Front-to-back depth of the outer (lateral) half of the cross-section at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.

S1_OW.description: Full width of the leg cross-section, side to side at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.

S1_OD.description: Full depth of the leg cross-section, front to back at slice S1 (20 percent of leg length above the bottom of the ankle), in millimeters. A leg measurement, not the Onshape variable of the same name.
